problem_text:
A logistics manager is selecting packages to load onto a cargo drone. The available packages are:
* Package A: volume 8 m³, revenue $299
* Package B: volume 23 m³, revenue $127
* Package C: volume 44 m³, revenue $289
* Package D: volume 43 m³, revenue $154
* Package E: volume 15 m³, revenue $132
* Package F: volume 5 m³, revenue $275
* Package G: volume 20 m³, revenue $177
* Package H: volume 15 m³, revenue $201
* Package I: volume 41 m³, revenue $255
* Package J: volume 19 m³, revenue $97
* Package K: volume 9 m³, revenue $17

The drone's cargo hold has a maximum capacity of 169 m³. Determine which combination of packages will yield the highest total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
